source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 14 March 1957, p. 5 ("BELFAST ELECTION: New councillor for Falls Ward"); Northern Whig, 14 March 1957, p. 3 ("P. J. Devlin elected for Falls Ward"); Belfast Telegraph, 14 March 1957, p. 13 ("New Councillor for Falls"); Belfast Telegraph, 25 January 1957, p. 6 ("City Councillor to resign (Hughes)")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter / Northern Whig / Belfast Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Northern Whig gives 1,261 to 675; News-Letter and Telegraph give 1,261 and a majority of 586 (1,261-675=586). Valid poll 1,936 is the sum of the two votes, not printed. Plurality election for one vacancy, no quota. Polling day Wednesday 13 March 1957 (BT 13 Mar 1957 p6 polling-day report).

note: By-election of 13 March 1957 for one seat in Falls (Belfast County Borough Council), caused by the resignation of Councillor (Francis) Cronan Hughes (Eire/Irish Labour), announced January 1957 for business reasons.
